simple.summary: כִּי (kîy) means a brand or scar First listed occurrence: Isa 3 24.

definitions.full: H3587. ki כִּי noun [masculine] burning, branding (for form, compare רִי from עִי צִי, אִי, רָוָה, : Kö ii. 1. 64 ) — only יֹ֑פִי תַּחַת כִּי Isa 3:24 branding instead of beauty , in judgment on women of Jerusalem. II. כִּי , branding , see below כוה .
